source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of polymers in artificial organs (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Hayatiyati tibb mein polymers masnoo aaza banane ke liye bohat ahem hain: insani banaye aalaat jo jism ke kharab ya bimar hisson ka kaam badalte ya sahara dete hain. Jism mein use hone wale polymers biocompatible, mechanically munasib, jaraseem se paak kiye ja sakne wale, der pa aur hasb-e-zaroorat badle ja sakne wale hone chahiye. Inhein jism ko nuqsan, allergy ya mudafiati nizam se radd nahi hona chahiye, aur in ki mazbooti, lachak ya khinchao us hisse ke mutabiq badla ja sakta hai jis ki jagah yeh lete hain (khoon ki nalon ke liye lachakdar, haddiyon ke liye mazboot).

blocks.prompt: PTFE masnoo khoon ki nalon ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh biocompatible hai aur is ki bohat hamwar satah khoon jamne se rokne mein madad deti hai.
